name: Timeless makes each Endless Sands stack cut spell costs by 3% (#1259)
contract: Timeless 706131 is a passive whose only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 and EffectBasePoints -4, resolving to -3 with DieSides 1. Its EffectSpellClassMask [0,0,8388608] selects exactly one SpellFamilyName 28 spell: Endless Sands 806728 (SpellFamilyFlags [0,0,8388608], StackAmount 5). Endless Sands effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT (72) with EffectMiscValue 127 (all schools) and EffectBasePoints -1, resolving to 0, so untalented the effect is worth nothing. SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 is folded into that effect's value by Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers through SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount then multiplies by the stack amount (SpellAuraEffects.cpp), which is the tooltip's 'per stack'. AuraEffect::HandleModPowerCostPCT writes UNIT_FIELD_POWER_COST_MULTIPLIER per school, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost multiplies the cost by (1 + multiplier). Endless Sands carries AttributesEx3 0x40010000 (SUPPRESS_CASTER_PROCS | DO_NOT_DISPLAY_RANGE), not SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS 0x20000000, so the modifier is not blocked. Epoch 501779 is used as the priced spell: PowerType 0 with ManaCostPercentage 18 and SchoolMask 80, whose first school is 4, one of the schools Endless Sands covers. Native handlers only. Regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Timeless self-applies its passive aura once learned
Endless Sands carries no SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 bonus without the talent
Timeless adds -3 to Endless Sands' second effect

Fixture five Endless Sands stacks on the control
Fixture five Endless Sands stacks on the talented Chronomancer
Untalented, Endless Sands' power cost effect stays at zero
With the talent, five stacks resolve to a 15% cost reduction
Endless Sands alone does not change Epoch's cost
Five talented Endless Sands stacks price Epoch 15% cheaper
